name: cinelanding
description: CLI and agent workflow for landing pages with cinematic scroll-linked transitions.

interface.shortDescription: Build landing pages with cinematic transitions.
interface.longDescription: CineLanding helps an agent redesign a public website or start from a brief. It includes a dependency-free CLI, free mock checks, an optional KIE.ai adapter, media processing, and instructions for building the result in a target frontend.
defaultPrompt: Redesign this website as a cinematic landing page.
Create a landing page from this brief and these assets.
Validate this CineLanding project before generation.
